featuredDestination.displayName: Boston Creek Cascades at Boston Creek Nature Area
featuredDestination.description: Several small unnamed stream ledges within a signed public nature-area loop, not an individually mapped tall named waterfall.
featuredDestination.trailWayfinding: Look for a nature-area sign on south side of Boston Cross Cut Road; approximately three visitor spaces; trail begins south end of lot and loops along creek

natureAreaCenter.role: OpenStreetMap mapped nature-area centre, not waterfall/trailhead/lot

heldCandidate.name: Upper Eagle River / Ten Foot Falls
heldCandidate.reviewResult: Hold: exact natural waterfall is independently documented and tourism describes an unsigned roadside gravel pull-off, but a legally cleared stopping site and complete bank walking rights still lack sufficient online source evidence.

risks: Map centre is the reserve polygon representative coordinate, NOT one specific cascade
No GPS car directions to map centre or historical informal pull-off
Small creek ledges are not a tall named waterfall; preserve the honest identity
Unmarked or unofficial footpath to an unnamed falls may not be inferred; follow signed KLT loop
November winter road, snow, bridges, and creek flow unknown
